findings.title: The frozen 200 MHz OOC target fails setup timing by 5.688 ns
findings.detail: Fresh Vivado 2025.2 synthesized OOC timing at 5.000 ns reports WNS=-5.688 ns, TNS=-34.130 ns, 6 setup-failing endpoints, WHS=+0.057 ns and WPWS=+1.968 ns. All six setup failures terminate at MM2S/S2MM descriptor_code_r[2:0]. The worst path is s_ctrl_mm2s_cmd_offset[22] to u_mm2s_channel/control/descriptor_code_r_reg[0]/D with 10.178 ns data delay and 54 logic levels (31 CARRY8, 19 LUT2, 1 LUT4, 3 LUT6). RTL lines 52-65 perform variable table selection, modulo by word_bytes_w and capacity checking in one acceptance cycle. Methodology reports six TIMING-16 warnings. This is synthesized OOC, not placed/routed timing, but the large failure blocks promotion to the indexed 5 ns target.
findings.required_action: Pipeline or algebraically simplify descriptor legality, then rerun independent 5 ns OOC and downstream integration timing. Do not waive this functional input-to-register path.

findings.title: The declared implementation-evidence packet is absent
findings.detail: At audit start the required run_001 directory contained no implementer source_manifest.sha256, subagent_result.json, kernel/module report, commands log, raw simulation log, or OOC report. The frozen index, contract and all seven indexed source identities were independently rehashed successfully, but an implementer evidence chain cannot be validated because none was supplied. Files now present under independent_verification are verifier-created and are not substitute implementation provenance.
findings.required_action: Produce a source-closed implementation evidence packet tied to the frozen index and exact source hashes, without overwriting this audit.

findings.title: The checked-in Vivado integration regression entry point fails before running the testbench
findings.detail: Fresh `bash scripts/run_integration_sim.sh` compiles and elaborates bank32/latency1, then Vivado 2025.2 xsim reports an unexpected Tcl exception for `xsim {integration_sim} -autoloadwcfg -runall`; the script rejects the ERROR and stops before the remaining configurations. An independent direct xsimk runner over the same elaborated snapshots passes all four required configurations, so this finding is the reproducibility entry point rather than a demonstrated RTL functional failure.
findings.required_action: Replace the failing xsim wrapper invocation with a checked, portable execution path and rerun the four-configuration regression.

static_audit.topology: one independent MM2S channel plus one independent S2MM channel; each owns a direction-local command queue and metadata FIFO
confirmed: descriptor error ordering 01 zero BTT, 02 DDR alignment, 03 33-bit overflow, 04 invalid bank, 05 local-offset alignment, 06 capacity
scheduler command ready is suppressed by pause, abort, fault, staged pending command, or full metadata FIFO
accepted DataMover command valid/data remain staged and stable independent of later pause or fault
metadata is pushed only for ordered descriptor rejection or DataMover command handshake
returned status checks FIFO-head tag, keep, last and DataMover success bits
completion is registered and retained until scheduler ready
transport faults preserve the FIFO head; descriptor errors retire in order
MM2S and S2MM selected-bank adapter controls are direction-local and independently operable
scheduler abort is latched, blocks new commands, and is forwarded only to the active adapter
common reset clears staged command, response, status/adapter observations and fault latch
static_audit.note: Default bank tables are only placeholder configuration and must be overridden to match integrated bank wrappers, as required by the contract.
